Plot an ellipse-distance or radius-distance model solution

Source: R/ellipse_mds.R
plot.mdspace_ellipse.Rd

which = "conf" draws each object as a point with its ellipse (Model II) or circle (Model III) in two dimensions. which = "semiaxis" draws the semiaxis configuration of Model II with the diagonal; when the points lie near the diagonal the ellipses are nearly circles and the orientation of the two dimensions is not determined (Okada & Imaizumi, 2024, Fig. 3.4).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mdspace_ellipse'
plot(x, which = c("conf", "semiaxis"), dims = c(1, 2), labels = TRUE, ...)

Arguments

x

An object of class mdspace_ellipse.

which

"conf" or "semiaxis".

dims

Two dimensions to plot.

labels

Logical; draw object labels.

...

Passed to graphics::plot().

Value

x, invisibly.
